out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at the back handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CDI: CFM placed hand soap at the back hand sink.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided at the handwashing sinks in the back main kitchen used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS instructed CFM to place handwashing sign at the back handwashing sink.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: uncooked beef stored above RTE deli sliced ham inside the True 2 Dr UR refrigerator (main kitchen across from cookline).
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: CFM relocated the uncooked beef to the bottom shelf inside the True 2 Dr UR refrigerator.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: deli sliced turkey and chicken soup stored in the True 2 Dr UR refrigerator (main kitchen across from cookline).
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CDI: CFM placed date mark label on the deli sliced turkey (5 remaining days) and chicken soup (6 remaining days) stored in the True 2 Dr UR with remaining hold dates before discard.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the ceiling (missing ceiling tile) is not maintained in good repair over the deep freezer in the back main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS instructed CFM to replace ceiling tile missing over the deep freezer in the back main kitchen area.

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: deli sliced turkey, provolone cheese inside the Delfield 4 Dr stacked refrigerator in the back kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. CDI: CFM placed date mark label on deli sliced turkey and deli sliced provolone cheese with remaining hold date (6 days remaining).

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Designated Storage for Clothing, Possessions
violations.observation: Observed employee possessions (nasal spray, gojo, scrubbing powder) stored in areas that may contaminate food-contact surface of equipment (surface of deli slicer)
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated lockers and clothes hooks to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. CDI: CFM employee items and relocated to employee designated storage area. CFM washed, rinsed, and sanitized the surface of the deli slicer.

violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS instructed CFM to place hand washing sign at hand sink.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed that clean kitchen equipment stored draining board on the clean side of the 3 compartment sink is directly under the hand soap dispenser at the hand sink and stored in an manner that exposed the items to contamination.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. EHS advised the CFM to revise the order of the 3 compartment sink set up and have the “clean” side of drain board be away from the hand soap dispenser.
